items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Teddy Wilson, another guy, very easy to play with, very easy to play with.

ctx.x: So instead of trying to battle with their strength, you let them take it.

Oh, yeah, yeah, follow them. Just join in, have a ball. It’s like playing with Count Basie. Just join in, nothing to it with him. He was the easiest guy— Teddy Wilson, another guy, very easy to play with, very easy to play with. Just tag along man, that’s all, have a ball, enjoy his music. I was a customer to him, you know, a paid customer. I’d sit there and I’d play the brushes, and no other idiot drummer could get up there and screw him up. I just played very simple behind him. But Dahlender was very good with…
